## Checks

- [ ] `tools/test.sh` passes (it needs no hardware and takes a few seconds)
- [ ] Builds - say which board, or `idf.py build` for the default one
- [ ] Tried on hardware, or say plainly that it was not
- [ ] A CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased, if this is worth a line in a release
